description: Login button unresponsive after session timeout on mobile Safari

analysis.root_cause: Mobile Safari likely freezes event listeners or retains stale session state after timeout, causing the login button click handler to fail silently due to a zombie session object or unresolved promise blocking the event loop
test_cases: Simulate session timeout on mobile Safari by waiting for session expiry period, then attempt to click the login button and verify it responds and triggers authentication flow
Force session timeout via API/cookie deletion on mobile Safari, reload the login page, and confirm the login button is clickable and submits credentials successfully
Test login button responsiveness on mobile Safari after returning to the app from background state post-session timeout to ensure event listeners are re-attached correctly
Verify login button behavior on mobile Safari when network is restored after being offline during session timeout to rule out network-related handler blocking
Compare login button click behavior across multiple iOS versions of Safari after session timeout to identify if the issue is version-specific
Inspect console errors on mobile Safari after session timeout and click attempt to confirm whether a stale promise, null reference, or blocked event handler is logged

description: Payment form accepts expired credit cards without validation

analysis.root_cause: Missing server-side and client-side expiration date validation logic that fails to compare card expiry month/year against current date
test_cases: Submit payment form with a credit card expired in a previous month of the current year and verify the form returns a validation error
Submit payment form with a credit card expired in a previous year and verify the transaction is rejected with an appropriate error message
Submit payment form with a credit card expiring in the current month and verify it is accepted as valid
Submit payment form with a future expiry date and confirm successful validation and payment processing
Attempt to bypass client-side validation by disabling JavaScript and submitting an expired card directly to the server endpoint and verify server-side rejection

description: Search results not updating when filter is changed rapidly

analysis.root_cause: Race condition in async search requests - rapid filter changes trigger multiple concurrent API calls where earlier requests may resolve after later ones, causing stale results to override current results
test_cases: Change filter rapidly 5 times in quick succession and verify final results match only the last selected filter
Apply a slow-network throttle and change filters rapidly to confirm the most recent filter result is displayed and not overridden by earlier responses
Change filter while a search request is in flight and verify the in-flight request is cancelled or ignored when superseded by a newer request
